comment.zh-TW: 主因是強風／側風。機場預報（TAF）10/23 08–20 時陣風 48–50 節、側風達 36.3 至 37.8 節；同兩格陣風超過 49 節的機率 82%，八個模式中七個與六個認為高。10/23 20 時–10/24 08 時陣風超過 49 節的機率仍有 51%，10/24 14 時後各格轉低。現已發布陸上颱風警報與陸上強風特報，整體停飛風險為高。

comment.zh-CN: 主因是强风／侧风。机场预报（TAF）10/23 08–20 时阵风 48–50 节、侧风达 36.3 至 37.8 节；同两个时段阵风超过 49 节的概率 82%，八个模式中七个与六个认为高。10/23 20 时–10/24 08 时阵风超过 49 节的概率仍有 51%，10/24 14 时后各时段转低。现已发布陆上台风警报与陆上强风特报，整体停飞风险为高。
comment.en: The main cause is strong wind and crosswind. The airport forecast (TAF) shows gusts of 48-50 kt and crosswind of 36.3 to 37.8 kt on 10/23 08:00-20:00; in those two periods there is an 82% chance of gusts over 49 kt, with seven and six of eight models saying High. From 10/23 20:00 to 10/24 08:00 the chance of gusts over 49 kt is still 51%, and periods after 10/24 14:00 turn Low. A land typhoon warning and a land strong wind advisory are in effect, so the overall disruption risk is High.

comment.en: The main cause of disruption risk is strong winds and crosswinds. Under the land typhoon warning for Typhoon Champi, the risk is High from 10/23 08:00 to 10/24 08:00. The airport forecast (TAF) for 10/23 08:00–20:00 shows mean winds of 38–40 kt, gusts of 48–50 kt, and crosswinds of 36.3–37.8 kt; six to seven of eight models say High, with an 82% chance of gusts over 49 kt. From 10/24 14:00, winds weaken and the disruption risk drops to Low.

comment.en: The disruption risk is High, mainly due to strong winds/crosswinds and heavy rain/thunderstorms. The most severe period is 10/23 14:00 to 10/24 02:00, when 4 to 5 of 8 models say High; during 10/23 14:00–20:00, the European model forecasts gusts of 53.6 kt and crosswind of 35.8 kt, with a 73% chance of gusts over 49 kt and a 98% chance of 24-hour rainfall over 50 mm. Risk drops to Low from 10/24 02:00.
